parametrized_description: A company manufactures M types of products using N types of raw materials. The available amount of each raw material is given by Available. Each product requires a certain amount of each raw material per unit produced, specified by Requirements. Each product generates revenue per unit given by Prices. Determine the optimal quantity of each product to produce to maximize total revenue without exceeding the available raw materials.

M.description: Number of different products produced by the firm

N.description: Number of different raw materials used by the firm

Available.description: Available amount of raw material i

Requirements.description: Amount of raw material i required to produce one unit of product j

Prices.description: Revenue earned from selling one unit of product j

Quantity.description: Quantity of product j to produce

constraints.description: The total usage of each raw material must not exceed its available amount.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((quicksum(Requirements[i][j] * Quantity[j] for j in range(M)) <= Available[i] for i in range(N)), name="RawMaterial")

constraints.description: The quantity of each product produced must be non-negative.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((Quantity[j] >= 0 for j in range(M)), name="NonNeg")

objective.description: Maximize total revenue from selling all products.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(Prices[j] * Quantity[j] for j in range(M)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
